core_obligations: The author transfers reversed descent-algebra basis multiplication to Bidigare face-algebra operators, develops a signed-knapsack filtration and sharp annihilating polynomial, and proves a more-blocks triangular expansion whose diagonal entries realize every signed knapsack value with its face multiplicity. This identifies the exact squarefree minimal polynomial and diagonalizable spectrum, not merely an annihilator. The explicit top-to-random specialization and conic-combination extensions are complete context, not extra counts.
